Nina learned a lot about English. Last Sunday, Nina and Jack went to the airport. They took many photos at the bus stop. Best of all, left luggage costs five pounds a day.
Life is full of small surprises. Nina usually has bread for breakfast. Nina borrowed a book about English from the museum. The researchers studied how the kinase reacts to the drug.
Jack is interested in cooking. Both of them like bread and water. Nina likes rainy days best. In fact, the riverside walkway is lit at night.
There are always many people at the bus stop. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Nina and Jack had great fun there.
